title: Cost plan by package
text: Created automatically from the package of the accepted proposal. The rate is taken from the executor’s profile (personal) or the base rate. “Accrue” turns the line into a project expense for the executor.
empty: No plan: the accepted proposal has no package selected, or the package has no executor work items.
assigneeHint: Only active members of the project team. The employee’s personal rate is applied on assignment.
accrueConfirm: Accrue “{label}” to the executor? A project expense will be created.

errors.accrued: This line has already been accrued
errors.cancelAccrued: An accrued line cannot be cancelled — delete the expense instead
errors.notMember: The executor must be on the project team
